Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 32
, Reason for Mistake: In its “New plan: Updated Fact Sheet,” the Orchestrator incorrectly assumed the 2025 Gold Pass ($99) included full 2024 season access and used it as the basis for the 2024 summer calculation instead of finding the actual 2024 season pass and 2024 daily ticket prices. This flawed assumption derailed the pricing basis and led to the unsupported final answer (200) rather than the correct $55 savings.
